description: The Kabbalistic Hebrew interpretive apparatus — reading Hebrew as a system where letter, number, and meaning are one substance. Covers gematria computation (the fixed letter-values, plene vs defective spelling, the standard methods), the hermeneutic operations (gematria, notarikon, temurah), letters as living entities with their own force (א the silent breath, ב the house, י the infinite point), root-pattern reading and right-to-left as effect-to-cause, and the sefirot/netivot framework. Treats equivalences as contemplative revelation within the tradition — honored, computed exactly, never oversold as literal proof. Use when asked to calculate gematria, read Hebrew Kabbalistically, find letter/number equivalences, work with sefirot, or engage Hebrew sacred text. Triggers on: 'gematria', 'calculate the gematria', 'Kabbalah', 'Hebrew letter mysticism', 'sefirot', 'notarikon', 'temurah'.
